notes.title: Kotlin null safety
notes.body: Safe-call (?.), Elvis (?:), nullable/non-nullable types and null coalescing. Compare Kotlin with Java.

notes.title: Higher-order and scope functions
notes.body: Higher-order functions, lambdas, inline functions, extension functions. Scope functions: let, run, also, with, apply.

notes.title: Kotlin language essentials
notes.body: Data classes vs normal classes, objects, immutability, type inference, collections, map vs hash map, marker interfaces.

notes.title: Coroutines and asynchronous work
notes.body: Coroutine builders: launch vs async. Suspend functions, coroutine scope, structured concurrency, worker services vs internet services.

notes.title: RxJava to coroutines and Flow
notes.body: Compare RxJava/Rx programming, AsyncTask and coroutines. Reactive programming with Flow and StateFlow.

notes.title: Android architecture
notes.body: MVI vs MVVM and unidirectional data flow (UDF). Design patterns, maintainable architecture, lifecycle and separation of concerns.

notes.title: UI state and state management
notes.body: Where should UI state live? How to update state safely across threads? How does state drive the UI?

notes.title: Jetpack Compose layouts
notes.body: Column, Row and Box. Vertical/horizontal arrangement and alignment. Compose basics and Material UI.

notes.title: Testing and CI/CD
notes.body: Unit testing with MockK, TDD, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment.

notes.title: Performance and UX
notes.body: UI responsiveness, performance optimization, multithreaded code and clean architecture.

notes.title: Backend and API integration
notes.body: REST APIs, API gateway, authentication/authorization, microservices and database relationships.

notes.title: EcoEats project
notes.body: Revisit EcoEats and review its architecture. Capture implementation decisions, blockers and lessons learned.

notes.title: Android learning roadmap
notes.body: Review Compose course, Android architecture, Kotlin reference material, and build a portfolio-ready Android app.
